This capacitor is particularly suitable for use as part of the resonant capacitor bank in ZVS induction-heater designs. Multiple capacitors can be connected in parallel when a higher total capacitance or current capability is required.
For example, a ZVS design using six 0.33µF capacitors in parallel provides approximately:
This configuration should be selected according to the particular induction coil, operating frequency, supply voltage, and resonant-tank design.
This is a non-polarized capacitor and can be installed in either orientation.

XKT-202 Ultrasonic Atomizer Driver Bare PCB – 108 kHz Water-Level Detection
The XKT-202 Ultrasonic Atomizer Driver Bare PCB is a compact DIY circuit board designed for building a small ultrasonic mist generator, humidifier, or atomizer using the XKT-202 controller IC.

The board is designed to drive a 108 kHz piezoelectric atomizing transducer through an external resonant inductor and MOSFET switching stage. It also provides a water-level monitoring function through dedicated sensing points, allowing the circuit to stop the atomizer when water is insufficient.
The PCB includes footprints for the XKT-202 IC, MOSFET, resonant inductor, capacitors, resistors, piezoelectric transducer connections, power input, and water-level sensing electrodes.
This product is supplied as a bare PCB for DIY assembly. Components are not installed.

uge-157982.summary: UNI-T UT71E is a high-precision True RMS digital multimeter with dual displays, data logging, USB interface, and power measurement for advanced diagnostics.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT71E is the flagship model in the UT71 series of intelligent digital multimeters, marrying precision measurement with advanced usability. Housed in a robust, ergonomically contoured case, the UT71E offers a generous 4¾-digit main display and dual 4,000-count secondary displays, ensuring that readings remain crisp and legible even in low-light or fast-changing conditions. A variable backlight can be toggled between two brightness levels or set to switch off automatically, balancing visibility with battery conservation .

Internally, the UT71E employs true RMS circuitry across its voltage and current ranges, affording accurate readings on both sinusoidal and distorted waveforms. This accuracy is complemented by an intelligent limit-setting function: users can define upper and lower thresholds, and the meter will audibly and visually alert whenever measurements stray beyond these bounds—an invaluable safeguard during mass-production testing or system commissioning . Under the hood, a high-speed microprocessor orchestrates auto-ranging, peak-hold capture, and a fast-responding analog bar-graph, delivering both detailed readouts and an intuitive, real-time sense of signal behavior.

. Power management is similarly polished: the meter will automatically shut off after an idle interval (customizable via its setup menu), and a low-battery icon prompts timely replacement of its single 9 V battery.

Physically, the UT71E is designed for both bench and field use. Rated CAT III 1000 V and CAT IV 600 V, it is built to withstand the demands of industrial environments. A knurled rotary switch, tactically separated function buttons, and a rigid tilt-stand combine to make measurements both rapid and comfortable. In the UT71E, UNI-T has crafted a tool that transcends basic electrical measurement—delivering intelligent, connected, and reliable performance for today’s complex testing needs.
True RMS measurement with high display count: Ensures accurate AC readings even on non-sinusoidal waveforms, dual 4,000-count secondary displays for maximum resolution and clarity.
Mis-plug alarm: Audible and visual warning if test leads are inserted into incorrect terminals, helping prevent measurement errors and instrument damage.
MAX/MIN/REL modes: Built-in functions to capture maximum, minimum, or relative (delta) values over time, with audible alerts when readings exceed predefined thresholds.
Selectable Auto or Manual ranging: Automatically selects the optimal measurement range for ease of use, or lets you lock in a fixed range when needed for more stable readings.
Data logging: Internal memory stores up to 100 readings (UT71E), which can be recalled on-device or sent via USB to the UNI-T Smart Measure App for analysis and reporting.

Auto power-off & backlight: Conserves battery life by automatically shutting down after a user-defined idle period and by switching the display backlight off after a set timeout, backlight can also be manually toggled between two brightness levels.

POWERBUS adopts the method of voltage transmission and current signal return, which provides high communication anti-interference ability. Cables can be laid in any way such as bus, tree or star, which greatly facilitates construction and wiring, and can prevent wrong connections and simplify construction and maintenance. RS-485 is a differential signal standard. Traditional RS-485 systems use at least four wires to simultaneously transmit signals and power: two wires for differential RS-485 signals, and two wires for power and ground. The weight and cost of these long cables increase system complexity and installation costs. Due to the use of multiple wires, there is a risk of system failure if the connection is incorrect, which further increases the complexity of the system.
Fortunately, when designing the RS-485 interface, the four-wire solution is no longer the only option.

makers-428017.summary: Axial Lead Inductor (0.5W) is a compact passive component with leads, designed to handle up to 0.5 watts for filtering and energy storage in circuits.

blocks.text: An Axial Lead Type Inductor is a type of passive electronic component that stores energy in a magnetic field when current flows through it. The “axial” refers to the lead configuration, where the leads extend from either end of the inductor, allowing for easy integration into circuits, especially on a breadboard or PCB (printed circuit board).

Inductors are an integral part of any electronic circuit as they help us to protect the circuit from the current surges that might happen of you start any high-power device and other RF interference in the circuit. But the inductors that come in different size and shapes like toroidal shaped, iron core, laminated core etc. For PCB application you need a small size inductor package that can be easily mounted to the PCB board like SMD package or this 1/2W Inductors for Through Hole Package that you can use simply as you use a resistor. You don’t have to worry about the big packaging size of the inductor and space on the PCB. They have color bands on them to read its inductance value. They do not have any polarity so that you can use them in any orientation. They can be easily used in filter applications, and in DC-DC converters etc..
An axial inductor provides inductance for small, low-power, low-current electronics projects. It is very similar in form factor with a resistor, but is usually colored green.
High quality color code inductor assortment kit and fixed Inductor.

A load bank is a piece of electrical test equipment used to simulate an electrical load, to test an electric power source without connecting it to its normal operating load. During testing, adjustment, calibration, or verification procedures, a load bank is connected to the output of a power source, such as an electric generator, battery, servoamplifier or photovoltaic system, in place of its usual load. The load bank presents the source with electrical characteristics similar to its standard operating load, while dissipating the power output that would normally be consumed by it. The power is usually converted to heat by a heavy duty resistor or bank of resistive heating elements in the device, and the heat removed by a forced air or water cooling system. The device usually also includes instruments for metering, load control, and overload protection. Load banks can either be permanently installed at a facility to be connected to a power source when needed, or portable versions can be used for testing power sources such as standby generators and batteries. They are necessary adjuncts to replicate, prove, and verify the real-life demands on critical power systems. They are also used during operation of intermittent renewable power sources such as windmills to shed excess power that the electric power grid cannot absorb.

MIC is an electret microphone. Its function is to sense the weak vibration of sound waves in the air and output the same electrical signal as the sound changes. This site uses a microphone with higher sensitivity, which can generally output an audio signal of more than tens of millivolts, which is enough to modulate the frequency of the next-level high-frequency oscillation signal. Note: The microphone has positive and negative poles, and the negative pole is generally connected to the case.

R1 is the bias resistance of the MIC electret microphone. With this resistance, the microphone can output audio signals. This is because the MIC microphone itself has a pole field effect tube amplifier circuit for impedance matching and improving output capabilities.
C2 is an audio signal coupling capacitor, which delivers the sound electrical signal output by the microphone to the next level.

C2 is the base filter capacitor of Q9018. On the one hand, it filters out high-frequency noise. On the other hand, the high-frequency potential of Q9018 is 0. For high-frequency circuits above 50MHz, Q9018 is a common base amplifier circuit. This is Finally, it can form the basis of oscillation. Because the basic condition of the oscillating circuit is that it must have a certain gain, and then it has feedback with a suitable phase (generally positive feedback).

R2 is the base bias resistor of Q9018, providing Q with a smaller base current, and Q will have a larger emitter current through R3. Because the current action in R2 and R3 will produce a voltage drop on their respective resistances and affect each other, the result will automatically stabilize at a certain value state, which is the emitter follower mentioned in the book.

R3 is the emitter resistance of Q9018, which serves to stabilize the DC operating point, and C6 also constitutes the role of high-frequency signal load resistance, which is also part of the entire high-frequency oscillation circuit.

C4 and L form a parallel resonant circuit, which plays the main role of selecting the oscillation frequency. Changing the capacity of C4 or changing the shape of L (including the number of turns) can easily change the transmission frequency.

C7 is a high-frequency signal output coupling capacitor, the purpose is to make the high-frequency signal into radio waves and radiate into the sky. Therefore, the antenna is best to be straight up, and the length is preferably equal to the radio wave frequency wavelength (or an integer multiple), and the surroundings should be wide open, without being blocked by metal objects. Note: The wavelength is equal to the reciprocal of the frequency. When the frequency changes, the wavelength will also change. Furthermore, the specific length of the antenna is also related to the output impedance of the circuit, the thickness of the antenna, etc. In amateur situations, just connect a piece of wire. (If you want to pursue the longest launch distance, you can try more in this area. The component package of this site has been tested by the technical staff of this site, and the effect can easily reach 50 meters away.)

C5 is the feedback capacitor, and the circuit starts to oscillate The key component is it. When analyzing the high-frequency state of this circuit, the collector is the output and the emitter is the input. The output signal is added to the input through C5, which generates strong positive feedback and naturally generates oscillation. This is actually the capacitive three-point oscillation circuit mentioned in the book.
C1 is the power supply filter capacitor, which provides a loop for the AC signal and reduces the AC internal resistance of the power supply.

Mandatory setup for the HV output leads
Set the gap before powering. Adjust the two HV output leads so they are close but not touching, then apply power. Do not power first and then bring them together, as that stresses the module.

For this family of modules, a safe working gap is typically ~10–20 mm. We recommend start at ~10–12 mm, then fine-tune within 10–20 mm; never let the wires touch and do not exceed ~20 mm (beyond that, energy can’t jump reliably and the module overheats).

makers-518745.summary: UAA1008A‑DP PLL Tuning Processor IC DIP‑24 for analog TV/FM tuner systems.

blocks.text: UAA1008A‑DP PLL Tuning Processor IC DIP‑24

The UAA1008A‑DP is a monolithic silicon integrated circuit engineered by Motorola as the analog interface core for digital television tuning memory systems. Far more than a simple support chip, it bridges the digital control section—using companion ICs such as the MC14425, MC14429, or MC14426—and the analog front-end of a TV set. The device integrates a precise digital‑to‑analog converter for varicap tuning voltage generation, dual‑rail regulated power supplies (a high‑voltage 34V varicap rail and a low‑noise 5V VDD supply for external CMOS logic), and a bank of three high‑current band‑switch drivers capable of sourcing up to 35mA each. Station capture logic processes negative‑going video modulation, positive flyback pulses, and a video carrier discriminator AFC signal, automatically gating the tuning window and verifying station presence. The UAA1008A‑DP thus replaces discrete tuning‑interface circuitry with a single, reliable 24‑pin DIP package, making it essential for restoring classic TV chassis or studying late‑20th‑century electronic tuning architectures.
Integrated digital‑to‑analog converter generates a precise varicap tuning voltage, eliminating complex discrete DAC circuits.
On‑chip 34V regulated supply for varicap diodes and a separate 5V regulated output for external logic (up to 10mA), ensuring stable operation.
Three dedicated band‑switch output drivers (VHF I, VHF III, UHF) with 35mA continuous current capability for direct tuner control.
Automatic station capture logic uses video, flyback, and AFC signals to enable reliable search‑and‑lock without external processors.
Analog television chassis with electronic tuning (e.g., Thorn TX9, TX10).
FM tuner systems with automatic station search.
Vintage hi‑fi receivers requiring PLL frequency synthesis.
Restoration and repair of 1980s consumer electronics.

blocks.text: TIL116 Optocoupler with Transistor Output 30V 5mA DIP-6

The TIL116 is an optically coupled isolator consisting of a gallium arsenide infrared emitting diode and a high-current transfer ratio silicon NPN phototransistor mounted in a plastic dual-in-line package. This design allows for electrical isolation between the input and output circuits, protecting sensitive control electronics from high voltages, ground loops, and noise on the output side. It is commonly used to interface logic signals between systems operating at different voltage potentials or to provide a safety barrier in power supply and motor control circuits. With its ability to handle continuous input current and provide a clean, amplified output signal, the TIL116 serves as a robust solution for digital logic interfacing and AC mains detection.

This optocoupler is characterized by its high direct-current transfer ratio, ensuring efficient signal transmission with minimal input drive. The device’s construction ensures stable performance across a wide range of humidity and temperature conditions, while its high-voltage electrical isolation makes it suitable for industrial and consumer applications requiring safety certification. The phototransistor output can switch loads up to 30 volts, making it compatible with TTL/CMOS logic and various microcontroller inputs. For applications needing to switch higher power loads, the TIL116 is often used to drive a separate power transistor or relay.

makers-492092.summary: The 74LS390 is a dual decade counter IC containing two independent divide-by-2 and divide-by-5 counters, used for frequency division.

blocks.text: The 74LS390 is a monolithic integrated circuit from the Texas Instruments LS (Low-Power Schottky) family, designed as a dual, independent 4-bit decade counter. This single package effectively contains two separate counter units, each built with internal master-slave flip-flops and additional gating logic. Its primary function is to count electronic pulses, and it is specifically configured to count in decades, meaning each counter cycles through ten distinct states (0-9) before resetting. This dual configuration is a key design aspect, aimed at significantly increasing system density by reducing the number of individual IC packages required for counting tasks.

Each of the two internal counters within the 74LS390 is not a single 4-bit counter but is itself composed of two smaller counters: a divide-by-2 section and a divide-by-5 section. These sub-counters have individual clock inputs (1CKA and 1CKB for the first counter, for example), providing flexibility in how the counting sequence is configured. The outputs of these sections can be interconnected in various ways, allowing each counter to implement different division ratios, including a full divide-by-10 sequence or a bi-quinary count (2 and 5) to produce a symmetrical square wave at the final output.

The device includes a direct clear (reset) input for each 4-bit counter, allowing for the immediate and asynchronous reset of the count to zero, independent of the clock signal. All outputs are buffered, which enhances output drive capability and reduces the possibility of noise issues during signal transitions. Characterized for operation from 0°C to 70°C, it is intended for use in commercial and industrial electronic systems where reliable, medium-speed counting and frequency division are required.
Contains two fully independent 2-bit and 5-bit counters in one package.
Can be used as a divide-by-2, divide-by-5, or divide-by-10 counter.

makers-487582.summary: A 100K ohm, 8-pin isolated resistor network in a compact SIP. Features a 2% tolerance and 0.125W rating, ideal for high-density circuit board designs.

blocks.text: The 100K ohm 8-pin resistor network is a consolidated electronic component that integrates multiple high-value resistors into a single, streamlined Single-In-Line Package (SIP). This design is pivotal for modern electronics, where board real estate is at a premium. By combining eight discrete components into one, it significantly reduces the part count on a PCB, which not only saves space but also enhances manufacturing efficiency and improves overall circuit reliability by minimizing potential failure points associated with numerous individual soldering joints.

This 8-pin network is designed with an “Isolated” circuit architecture, denoted by the letter ‘B’. In this configuration, each of the resistors is entirely independent of the others, with no internal common connection. This provides a circuit designer with maximum flexibility, allowing each 100K ohm resistor to be deployed in separate and unrelated parts of a circuit simultaneously, just as if eight separate through-hole resistors were being used, but with the significant benefits of integrated packaging.

Manufactured with a focus on durability and consistent performance, this network utilizes high-reliability materials like RU02 paste. The component is clearly identified by a marking such as “B104G” on its body. This code is essential for quick identification, revealing the isolated circuit type, confirming the 100,000-ohm resistance value for each internal resistor, and guaranteeing a precise manufacturing tolerance of ±2% for design accuracy.

Rise time and fall time is about 60ns and 45ns respectively.
It is commonly used with Arduino, due to its low threshold current.

blocks.text: The IRFZ44N is known for its high drain current and fast switching speed. Adding to that it also has a low Rds value which will help in increasing the efficiency of switching circuits. The MOSFET will start turning on with a small gate voltage of 4V, but the drain current will be maximum only when a gate voltage of 10V is applied. If the mosfet has to be driven directly from a microcontroller like Arduino then try the logic level version IRLZ44N mosfet.
Difference between IRLZ44N and IRFZ44N Mosfet

The IRLZ44N and IRFZ44N MOSFETs are often confused among each other and used incorrectly. The IRLZ44N is a Logic level Mosfet with a very low gate threshold voltage of 5V, meaning the MOSFET can be fully turned on with just 5V on its gate pin which avoids the need for a driver circuit.

The IRFZ44N on the other hand requires a gate driver circuit if the MOSFET has to be turned on completely using a microcontroller like Arduino. However it does turn on partially with direct 5V form a I/O pin, but the output drain current will be limited.

Unlike transistors MOSFET’s are voltage controlled devices. Meaning, they can be turned on or turned off by supplying the required Gate threshold voltage (VGS). IRFZ44N is an N-channel MOSFET, so the Drain and Source pins will be left open when there is no voltage applied to the gate pin. When a gate voltage is applied these pins gets closed.

If it is required to be switched with Arduino, then a simple drive circuit using a transistor will work to provide the required gate voltage to trigger the MOSFET to open fully. For other switching and amplifying applications, a dedicated MOFET Driver IC is required.

If the MOSFET gate pin is directly connected to an I/O pin of a microcontroller like Arduino, PIC, etc. Then it will not open completely and the maximum drain current will depend on the voltage applied to the gate pin. The below graph shows how much drain current is permitted for gate threshold voltage from 4V to 10V.
As you can see the MOSFET opens completely only when the gate voltage is around 10V. If it is somewhere around 5V then the drain current is limited to 20A and so on.

makers-349356.summary: A dual 4-bit static shift register with serial input and parallel outputs. Features a master reset for each register and operates from 3V to 18V.

blocks.text: 4015 IC Shift Register Serial to parallel PDIP-16 Original

The CD4015B is a monolithic CMOS integrated circuit that functions as a dual 4-bit static shift register. Its primary role is to convert serial data into parallel data, operating as a serial-in, parallel-out (SIPO) register. The device is constructed using complementary MOS technology, which provides it with the classic benefits of very low power consumption and a wide operating voltage range. This makes it a versatile and robust building block for various digital logic systems, capable of interfacing with both CMOS and TTL logic families when operated at a suitable voltage.

The IC contains two identical and completely independent shift registers on a single chip. Each register has its own dedicated data input, clock input, and a master reset input, allowing for flexible and separate control. Data presented at the serial input is shifted into the register on the low-to-high transition of the clock pulse. The master reset input, when set to a high logic level, asynchronously clears all stages of its respective register, forcing all outputs to a low state, regardless of the clock or data input conditions.

Each of the four stages in a register is represented by a Q output, providing parallel access to the shifted data. The data bit moves from one stage to the next with each clock pulse, effectively creating a delay line or a means to hold multiple bits of data. This parallel output structure is ideal for tasks like driving multiple outputs from a single serial data line, such as illuminating LEDs or controlling other digital loads, thereby reducing the number of microcontroller I/O pins required in a system.
Fully Static Operation (Does not require a minimum clock frequency).

The 6N135 is a high speed Optocoupler with Transistor output. It can switch at a speed of 1 Mbit/s with Bandwidth of 2MHz. It is TTL compatible with open collector output commonly used in Power supply circuits like inverter or in Data transfer circuits as logic isolators.

blocks.text: Note: More details can be found at the 6N135 optocoupler datasheet which is available for download at the end of this page.

The 6N135 is a High Speed Optocoupler or Optoisolator. As we know the term Optocoupler/Optoisolater means we use light to indirectly couple (isolate) two sets of circuits. The speciality of 6N135 is that it has a high speed LED and hence can switch at 1Mbit/sec the output of the coupler is a TTL logic transistor making it easy to interface with other circuits.

The 6N135 is very similar to 6N137, the major difference is that 6N135 has transistor output and 6N137 has NAND output Enabling it to have high switching speed of 10Mbit/sec compared with the 1Mbit/sec of 6N135.

The maximum operating voltage of 6N135 is 15V and the transistor has an output current of 8mA with a peak of 16mA making it suitable to drive medium level loads. If you looking for some high voltage AC/DC switching try the MOC3021. Apart from that the IC also has an Enable pin which comes in handy while designing a strobe circuit for your camera flash.
So if you are looking for a high speed optocoupler for some digital applications like data conversion or noise elimination then this IC might be of interest to you.

Even though 6N135 is capable of working with both AC and DC it is commonly used with Digital circuits and works with 5V as supply voltage. A typical application circuit for 6N135 from data sheet is shown below

The Capacitor 0.1uF is a bypass capacitor across the Supply rail. The input signal should has an impedance of minimum 50 ohms with rise time and falls of 5nS of greater for the IC to respond. The input signal can be probed (if required) on pin 3 and the pull down resistor 100Ω is optional and can be used only if you are connecting the signal to scope.

As told earlier the output (pin 6) is an open drain transistor and hence it can either sink current or remain floating. So to avoid floating we should use a pull up resistor RL, the value of RL can be between 330 ohm to 4K depending upon the load connected.

The pin 7 is the Enable pin, this pin has an in-built pull up resistor hence by default the IC is enabled when powered. When connected to ground it will disable the output. The pin can be put into use to create strobe circuits etc.. The below truth table will help you understand the working of Enable pin.

Since the output is of open drain type, note that when the input is high the output will be low and vice versa. Since the IC is commonly used for fast switching another thing to consider is the propagation delay. When the input is logic on the output turn off only after (TPHL) and when the input is logic off the output turns on only after (TPLH). The same can be understood with the below switching diagram.

blocks.text: The RCWL-0516 Microwave distance sensor uses microwave frequencies in a simple implementation of a Doppler radar. The circuitry inside the chip processes the signal and outputs an analog voltage that is proportional to the distance between the object and sensor.

blocks.v: OUT · Analog output from the sensor

blocks.text: Components Present on the RCWL0516 Module
The following are the major components present in the module, which will be described later in the article.
RCWL0516 IC, transistors, capacitors, and resistors.
Note: Complete technical details can be found in the RCWL-0516 Datasheet linked at the bottom of this page.
The RCWL-0516 is a distance sensor that uses microwave frequencies in a simple implementation of a Doppler radar.

The antenna generates and receives radio waves from an object, which is then sent to a mixer. The circuitry inside the chip processes the signal and outputs an analog voltage that is proportional to the distance between the object and sensor.
Internal Circuit Diagram for RCWL0516 Module

RCWL0516 IC, which is a complete RF Doppler system in a chip is the heart of the module. The peripheral components act as power supply decoupling and filtering and set operating points. The RF section consists of a high-speed NPN transistor Q1, which forms a Colpitts oscillator. The antenna is a trace on the PCB.

The transistor Q1 also acts as a mixer that combines the transmitted and received signal and outputs the difference which is filtered by the low pass filter formed by C9 and R8, and is amplified by the IC. This signal can be treated the same way as the signal from a PIR sensor.
How to use the RCWL0516 Module?

The output of the RCWL0516 sensor is analog and can be connected to an analog input of a microcontroller and sampled by an ADC. The output voltage is roughly proportional to the distance between the sensor and the object. However, since it relies on a Doppler radar system, signal reflections from other nearby objects can interfere with the measurement, making it less reliable and accurate than other kinds of sensors. The reflections from different kinds of objects can also influence measurements, for example, metallic objects have a stronger reflection than plastic objects.

Check if the correct pin is connected to the microcontroller
If the signal is intermittent or distorted:
Check the clearance between the sensor and the object to be measured and other objects.

blocks.text: Raspberry Pi Dual Cooling Fan 5V with Heatsink Kit for Pi 3B / 3B+ / 4B

It is especially useful in projects where the board runs for extended periods, handles continuous processing, or operates in enclosed spaces where passive cooling alone may not be enough.

This kit combines two cooling fans with a heatsink-based thermal design to provide active airflow across the main processing area of the Raspberry Pi. Once installed, the heatsink helps draw heat away from the processor, while the dual-fan assembly increases airflow to improve cooling efficiency and support more stable system performance.

The main heatsink structure is designed for direct installation on the Raspberry Pi CPU area using adhesive thermal interface material, which helps create close thermal contact for better heat transfer. The included dual-fan unit operates from 5V DC, making it easy to power directly from the Raspberry Pi GPIO header. This allows a simple installation method without requiring a separate external power supply.

The kit is suitable for Raspberry Pi 3B, Raspberry Pi 3B+, and Raspberry Pi 4B, and is useful in media systems, embedded projects, home automation, server-style installations, networking tasks, and DIY electronics builds where thermal management is important.

يعتمد هذا الطقم على مروحتين للتبريد مع مشتت حراري لتوفير حل تبريد نشط يساعد على سحب الحرارة من المعالج ونشرها بشكل أفضل، ثم دفع الهواء فوق سطح المشتت لتحسين كفاءة التخلص من الحرارة. هذا يساهم في الحفاظ على درجة حرارة أكثر استقرارًا ويدعم أداء اللوحة أثناء العمل المتواصل.

يتم تثبيت المشتت الحراري على منطقة المعالج باستخدام لاصق حراري أو وسادة حرارية موصلة، مما يساعد على تحسين انتقال الحرارة من سطح المعالج إلى المشتت. أما وحدة المروحتين فتعمل بجهد 5 فولت تيار مستمر، ويمكن توصيلها مباشرة من خلال أطراف التغذية المناسبة في لوحة رازبيري باي، مما يجعل التركيب بسيطًا وعمليًا دون الحاجة إلى مصدر طاقة خارجي مستقل.

هذا الطقم مناسب للوحات Raspberry Pi 3B وRaspberry Pi 3B+ وRaspberry Pi 4B، ويُستخدم في تطبيقات مثل أنظمة الوسائط، والمشروعات المدمجة، وأنظمة الأتمتة، والسيرفرات الصغيرة، ووحدات الشبكات، وتجارب التطوير الإلكتروني التي تتطلب تبريدًا إضافيًا.

12.6V 40Ah High Drain Rechargeable Lithium-ion Battery Pack

The 12.6V 40Ah High Drain Rechargeable Battery Pack is built for applications that need serious energy capacity along with strong and stable current delivery. With an impressive 40Ah capacity and a 40A maximum discharge current, this battery pack is a practical solution for users who need long operating time without giving up the ability to power demanding 12V loads.

Designed in a 3S14P lithium-ion configuration, this battery pack uses a high cell-count structure that helps distribute current more effectively across the pack. This supports better voltage stability during operation and helps reduce stress on individual cells, making the battery more suitable for extended use in demanding environments. The result is a power source that combines endurance, stability, and dependable high-drain performance in one compact assembly.

This battery is suitable for a wide range of practical applications including portable 12V refrigerators, LED lighting systems, backup power setups, mobile workstations, field equipment, portable solar storage, small inverter systems, and custom engineering builds. Its large capacity makes it especially useful where runtime is a priority, while its high drain capability allows it to support devices with higher startup or operating current requirements.

The integrated protection system helps improve safety and reliability by protecting the battery and connected equipment against overcharge, over-discharge, short circuit, and related electrical risks. This makes the battery more dependable for repeated use in both mobile and fixed installations.

For users who need a rechargeable 12.6V high drain battery with maximum runtime and reliable output, this battery pack offers a strong combination of large capacity, practical high-current capability, and long-use convenience.

بطارية ليثيوم أيون قابلة لإعادة الشحن 12.6 فولت 40 أمبير – تفريغ عالي حتى 40 أمبير بتصميم 3S14P عالي السعة
بطارية ليثيوم أيون قابلة لإعادة الشحن 12.6 فولت 40 أمبير

تم تصميم بطارية 12.6 فولت 40 أمبير تفريغ عالي لتكون خيارًا مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى سعة كبيرة جدًا مع قدرة ممتازة على تزويد الأحمال بالتيار بشكل ثابت وموثوق. بفضل السعة الكبيرة 40 أمبير وأقصى تيار تفريغ يصل إلى 40 أمبير، توفر هذه البطارية توازنًا ممتازًا بين زمن التشغيل الطويل والقدرة على تشغيل أنظمة 12 فولت التي تحتاج إلى أداء قوي ومستقر.

تعتمد البطارية على تكوين 3S14P، وهو تصميم يساعد على توزيع الحمل الكهربائي بشكل أفضل بين الخلايا، مما يدعم استقرار الجهد أثناء التشغيل ويقلل الضغط على كل خلية بصورة أكبر. هذا ينعكس بشكل عملي على الاعتمادية، وثبات الأداء، والقدرة على العمل لفترات أطول في التطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى مصدر طاقة قوي وقابل لإعادة الشحن.

تصلح هذه البطارية لمجموعة واسعة من الاستخدامات مثل أنظمة التخييم خارج الشبكة، والثلاجات المحمولة بجهد 12 فولت، والمراوح، ووحدات الإضاءة، وأنظمة الطاقة الاحتياطية لأجهزة الشبكات والاتصال، وبعض تطبيقات تخزين الطاقة الشمسية الصغيرة، بالإضافة إلى المشاريع الهندسية والأنظمة المتنقلة. كما أنها مناسبة للمستخدمين الذين يحتاجون إلى بطارية تمنحهم زمن تشغيل أطول دون التضحية بقدرة السحب العالية عند الحاجة.

كما تحتوي البطارية على نظام حماية داخلي يساعد على حماية البطارية والأجهزة المتصلة بها من الشحن الزائد، والتفريغ الزائد، والقصر الكهربائي، وبعض حالات زيادة التيار، مما يرفع مستوى الأمان أثناء الاستخدام ويحسن من موثوقية التشغيل في الاستخدام العملي المتكرر.

إذا كنت تبحث عن بطارية ليثيوم قابلة لإعادة الشحن بجهد 12.6 فولت وسعة 40 أمبير لتطبيقات تحتاج إلى سعة كبيرة مع أداء قوي، فإن هذه البطارية تقدم لك حلًا عمليًا يجمع بين الاعتمادية، والسعة العالية، وثبات الأداء، وسهولة الاستخدام.

blocks.text: Zener Diode 6.8V 0.5W is a high-quality, glass encapsulated voltage regulation diode designed for precise and reliable stabilization of voltage at 6.8 volts. Ideal for electronics applications such as power supplies, voltage references, and transient protection, this Zener diode features a DO-35 axial package—one of the industry standards for compact but rugged components. Whether you are a professional engineer or a hobbyist, the Zener Diode 6.8V 0.5W offers dependable performance and thermal stability.

The Zener Diode 6.8V 0.5W is a variant of the popular DO-35 Zener family. It is designed to limit voltage at exactly 6.8 volts when reverse-biased, making it perfect for voltage regulation in low-power electronics. With a power rating of 0.5 W and a tolerance of ±5%, this diode delivers stable voltage under normal operating conditions. It can also handle momentary voltage surges when used within its specified ratings.

With its nominal Zener voltage of 6.8 V and ±5% tolerance, the Zener Diode 6.8V 0.5W maintains output voltage within a narrow and predictable band—crucial for sensitive analog circuits and microcontroller references.
Rated at 0.5 W, this Zener diode can dissipate up to 500 mW of power. Ideal for clipping, reference rails, or small voltage regulator designs where moderate current flows are required.

Featuring a reverse leakage current of just 2 µA @ 3.5 V, the Zener Diode 6.8V 0.5W minimizes unintended current drain, which helps maintain battery life in portable electronic products and reduce noise in precision circuits.

With a Zener impedance (Zzt) of only 8 Ω, this diode responds more sharply to voltage deviations, providing tighter voltage regulation and improved curve sharpness compared to higher impedance variants.
The DO-35 glass axial package allows mounting in any orientation (vertical, horizontal, or elevated). Its black cathode band clearly identifies polarity, reducing assembly errors in cluttered PCBs.

Some of the important features of flexible shaft coupling are,
Helical cut makes them behave like a springy in the X Y and Z linear axis but not in the rotational axis. That means that you won’t get more backlash, hence they are suitable for precision CNC work.

A coupling is a device which transmits power and torque. Couplings do not normally allow disconnection of shafts during operation. However, there are torque limiting couplings which can slip or disconnect when some torque limit exceeds.

The Ublox GY-NEO-7M-0-000 GPS Module for Arduino with Antenna is a device for tracking the location of an object where GPS is installed, sending data regarding its latitude, longitude, date, time and speed of travel.

The installation of the Ublox GY-NEO-7M GPS Module for Arduino in the vast majority of projects takes place in aerial or vehicular prototypes, where the user can track via smartphone or computer the coordinates and speed of the prototype.

Another important application that can be given is to command a robot to perform different tasks in predefined locations and times. To perform such tasks the microcontroller needs to be programmed, and it may be necessary to apply other accessories.
This module comes with a ceramic antenna and an IPEX interface to connect to other active antennas, it has a serial interface from 3.3V to 5V, ideal for working with numerous microcontrollers.
Its LED indicates its status, namely:
– Always on: normal operation, but not positioned.
PSS pin is internally connected to the LED, indicating its status.
It can become unstable in closed times.

To use the manufacturer’s software is quite simple, just download it, install your component as well as vc_redist and open it. Connect your GPS module via USB and select in the “Receiver->Connection” program and choose the wake port of the GPS connection.
With it you can check all the signals from the satellites and when you get the connection you can track the map.
Images from the Manufacturer Software Ublox for viewing the NEO-7M GPS data
Using Arduino Ublox NEO-7M-0-000 GPS Module with arduino
To use this module with the Arduino, just connect it to two digital ports and use the SoftwareSerial library to perform communications.

With the help of the TinyGPS library, we can read this data efficiently and extract information such as latitude, longitude, speed, altitude, and UTC time. In this way, we can easily integrate the GPS module into our projects and get accurate positioning and navigation readings.

The Zener Diode 9V 0.5W is designed to provide voltage stabilization and overvoltage protection in sensitive analog and digital circuits. blocks.text: Mercury switches have one or more sets of electrical contacts in a sealed glass envelope that contains a small quantity of mercury. The envelope may also contain hydrogen at pressure, an inert gas, or a vacuum. Gravity constantly pulls the drop of mercury to the lowest point in the envelope. When the switch is tilted in the appropriate direction, the mercury touches a set of contacts, thus completing an electrical circuit. Tilting the switch in the opposite direction moves the mercury away from that set of contacts, breaking that circuit.
The contacts are enclosed, so oxidation of the contact points is impossible.
In hazardous locations, interrupting the circuit does not emit a spark that could ignite flammable gases.
Contacts stay clean, and even if an internal arc occurs, the contact surfaces renew on every operation, so they don’t wear out.
Even a small drop of mercury has low resistance, so switches can carry useful amounts of current in a small size.
The sensitivity of the drop to gravity provides a unique sensing function and lends itself to simple, low-force mechanisms for manual or automatic operation.
The switches are quiet, as no contacts abruptly snap together.
The mass of the moving mercury drop provides an over-center effect to avoid chattering as the switch tilts.

lancer3d-33906.summary: Boost your 3D printer with the Creality Sonic Pad. Featuring Klipper firmware, a 7-inch touchscreen, Wi-Fi connectivity, and support for faster, higher-quality printing with easy remote control.

blocks.text: Unlock the full potential of your 3D printer with the Creality Sonic Pad, an intelligent Klipper-based controller designed to dramatically improve printing speed, quality, and workflow. Equipped with a 7-inch full-color capacitive touchscreen and powered by a 64-bit quad-core processor, the Sonic Pad delivers a smooth, responsive user experience while simplifying printer control for both beginners and experienced makers.

Pre-installed with Klipper firmware, the Sonic Pad enables print speeds of up to 2–5× faster than traditional Marlin firmware by utilizing advanced motion planning, Input Shaping, and Pressure Advance technologies. These features effectively reduce ringing, ghosting, and extrusion inconsistencies, allowing you to produce high-quality prints at significantly higher speeds.

Installation is quick and straightforward using the included serial cable, allowing many supported Creality FDM printers to be upgraded without replacing the original motherboard. The Sonic Pad also supports a wide range of third-party Klipper-compatible FDM printers, making it a flexible upgrade for multiple printer setups.

With Wi-Fi and Ethernet connectivity, users can remotely upload G-code, start and manage prints, monitor printing progress, and receive OTA (Over-the-Air) firmware updates. The built-in web interface provides convenient access from a computer, tablet, or smartphone, while webcam support enables real-time remote print monitoring.

The Sonic Pad also features multi-printer management, allowing a single controller to operate multiple compatible 3D printers simultaneously—an ideal solution for workshops, print farms, schools, and professional users.
Whether you’re looking to increase productivity, achieve smoother prints, or simplify printer management, the Creality Sonic Pad is a powerful all-in-one upgrade for modern FDM 3D printing.
